changes: Delsys credentials moved to ignored local/delsys.json
Training: extracted LiteCNN1D, preserved semantic class order; new EMG-specific pipeline and single-channel support
classroom_changes: Delsys embedded SDK license moved into ignored local/delsys.json and environment variables.
Cometa/Delsys receive on_error callbacks; Cometa no longer silently discards queued frames.
Delsys sample alignment buffers surplus channel samples in emg_lab/alignment.py.
LiteCNN1D_channels_v2 preserves the sensor dimension before extracting features; EMG training and train-only normalization are implemented separately.
Raw EMG uses source binary header layout; labels use sample indices and JSON stores exact sample rate.
Classroom UX revision: one session per .emg archive; each trial contains forward/rest/left/right once; whole-trial training with optional holdout; legacy recordings retained.

2026-10-16: fixed default waveform axes with shared device/capture display settings; waveform-first collection pages and separate neutral-pose Revo2 capture window; pinned action bars and collapsible settings; idle real-hand/DDS connection before inference, output enable/stop separate from connection, retained stop errors; offline lifecycle and GUI validation.
private_package_origin: Internal Nexus pypi-group; authentication is not stored in this repository.

adaptations: Two-column per-sensor plots with numeric amplitude axes; no host event bus or hardware-manager dependency
Time window in seconds, shared/individual/fixed amplitude ranges, raw/filtered overlay and display-only pause
Preserve signal amplitudes and source unit labels; peak downsampling only affects drawing

robot_scene.implementation: emg_lab/physics; local copy of the validated g1_physics_demo controller, no runtime sibling dependency
robot_scene.controller: NVIDIA Decoupled WBC Balance/Walk, CPU ONNX, unchanged pretrained weights
changes: Shared physical scene for cue-driven collection and stable-classification-driven live/replay inference
Asynchronous loading and standing before collection or replay starts; closing/failure ends and saves the experiment
Only fresh predictions renew the command watchdog; no keyboard overrides during EMG experiments
Fixed rest countdown to use the current action segment; class IDs, data format and DDS mapping unchanged
Restored source outdoor visuals, exact third-person camera parameters and position/heading smoothing; robot physics and policy assets unchanged.
Copied source cue textures and meshes; adapted GroundCuePresenter to append to the offscreen scene without clearing the world. Bundled countdown badges use the source renderer.
Default acquisition now preparation 3 s / active 3 s / extra rest 0 s. Preparation shows 3, 2, 1, then 0 for its last 0.3 s; active-only ground cues use the same sample-clock phase as labels.

default_comparison.note: The source backend accepts page-specified epochs and trainable timestamp intervals, without controlling capture timing. Source trials are individual actions; classroom trials contain all four actions by design.

emg_model_fix.initial_adaptation: max(1,num_channels//2) for single-channel support; two channels still collapsed to one
emg_model_fix.cause: Premature mixing of two independent muscles confused one-sided and simultaneous activation; argmax-only evaluation hid command gating failures.
emg_model_fix.evaluation: Exported ONNX is replayed with the deployed InferencePipeline; score held-out action windows only, preserving continuous filter and gate context.
emg_model_fix.compatibility: Existing ONNX and metadata preserved; old scores explicitly labelled as window-only evaluation.
